name: suitespot
description: BakkesMod plugin for Rocket League — post-match training automation

dependencies.name: sqlite3
dependencies.description: Persistent storage — replace/augment JSON flat files for pack stats, usage history, and future relational data

dependencies.name: spdlog
dependencies.description: Structured, level-filtered logging with file sink — augments the existing LOG() macros with rotation and observability

dependencies.name: fmt
dependencies.description: Fast, type-safe string formatting — already used indirectly via spdlog; explicit inclusion enables standalone use

dependencies.name: nlohmann-json
dependencies.description: Managed replacement for the vendored IMGUI/json.hpp — identical API, keeps vcpkg as the single source of truth

dependencies.name: openssl
dependencies.description: TLS/HTTPS support for future direct HTTP integrations outside BakkesMod HttpWrapper (e.g. auth flows, signed requests)

dependencies.name: ixwebsocket
dependencies.description: WebSocket client — enables real-time data feeds (live pack leaderboards, community events, stat streaming)
